name: Varina, Lich Queen

abilities.text: Whenever you attack with one or more Zombies, draw that many cards, then discard that many cards. You gain that much life.
{2}, Exile two cards from your graveyard: Create a tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

notes: The trigger's 'that many' has nothing to feed it (the you-attack event carries no amount), so the DRAW counts the attacking Zombies you control and the discard and the life gain read that amount back as 'that many'. The trigger fires on every attack; with no Zombie attacking the count is 0 and nothing happens.

issues: Whenever you attack with ONE OR MORE ZOMBIES, ... — expected The ability does not trigger at all unless at least one attacking creature is a Zombie. — scripted event {on:'you-attack'} with no filter; game.ts:2275 fires it whenever ctx.player === controller, i.e. every combat you attack in. A do-nothing trigger (draw 0 / discard 0 / gain 0) goes on the stack — observable to opponents and to 'whenever a triggered ability triggers' effects. — CR 603.2

draw that many cards, then discard that many cards. You gain that much life. — expected 'that many' is fixed by the triggering event (the number of Zombies that attacked) and does not change if those Zombies later leave. — scripted the draw counts {count:'objects', filter:{subtypes:['Zombie'], attacking:true}} at RESOLUTION; kill an attacking Zombie in response and the count drops. (The discard/gain-life chaining off 'that-many' is correct.) — CR 603.2, 608.2

{2}, Exile two cards from your graveyard: — expected you choose which two cards to exile as you pay the cost — scripted cost.exileFromGraveyard: 2 — game.ts:687 exiles gy[0] and gy[1] with no choice, and its loop guard (`i < gy.length`) would even let a partial payment through. — CR 601.2h

card frame — expected the printed card also has 'Flying, vigilance, lifelink' — scripted absent from the batch oracleText itself, so the script is faithful to the supplied text — flagging as a data concern, not scored. — CR n/a

Whenever you attack with one or more Zombies — expected The ability only triggers if at least one attacking creature is a Zombie. — scripted event {on:'you-attack'} with no filter or condition — game.ts:2275 fires for any attack by the controller, putting a draw-0/discard-0/gain-0 trigger on the stack. Observable: priority passes, and 'whenever a triggered ability triggers' effects see it. — CR CR 603.2
